purpose: An owned CPU 1511-1 PN program whose cyclic interrupt OB30 is assigned to process image partition 1, so SingleStep_P and TimespanSynchronized_P have a partition update to stop at. The OB1-only fixture of 7 and 8 November 2026 had none and both modes ended sessionUnavailable after their first sync point.
authoring: Authored text, not a native export. The runner scripts/qualify_plcsim_process_image.py builds the project from these files in an owned scratch; nothing here was imported or run natively.

signals.role: Incremented once per OB30 start, i.e. per update of process image partition 1.

expectations.SingleStep_P: durationLimit, and Ob30Count differs between successive rows.
expectations.TimespanSynchronized_P: durationLimit, and Ob30Count differs between successive rows.

unverified: That block_import_xml keeps SecondaryType CyclicInterrupt on OB30 in this program (it did in qualify_plcsim_gaps.py for the other interrupt OBs).
That CyclicTime is in microseconds and that block_attributes_set may write ProcessImagePartNumber on a cyclic OB (the tool's allowlist names both; no native run wrote them).

That an OB assignment alone gives PLCSIM a partition to synchronise on. No tool writes the process image of an I/O module's addresses, so the partition stays empty; if the modes still stall, the module assignment is the next thing to author.
Partition-synchronous stepping needs SYNC_PI/SYNC_PO only for isochronous OBs (API manual 9.12.1.1); this fixture has none, so SingleStep_Bus stays unqualified.
